task: Capstone 2 Defense Preparation, Live Secretary Minutes (OVPAA-F-INS-032), Client Section, and Action Done Matrix (ADM) Real-Time Synchronization
summary: Implemented complete Capstone 2 defense progression workflow: Adviser manuscript endorsement handoff triggering instructor notification and pending_scheduling status; Instructor defense scheduling modal; BukSU Form OVPAA-F-INS-032 live defense minutes studio with dedicated Client section (Dr. Sales G. Aribe Jr.); atomic publish-to-ADM converting panelist and client remarks with (Client) distinction; real-time WebSocket sync (defense:minutes_updated); student post-defense revised manuscript upload dialog (v2); unblocked Capstone 2 ActionDoneMatrixTab; and portal attachment for all dialogs.
lessons_learned: Lesson: Modals in CMS-V2 mounted inside DashboardLayout must use createPortal(modalContent, document.body) to escape the .cms-route-enter transform stacking context.
Lesson: Defense minutes entries must support isClient boolean flag and clientComments list so that client remarks carry (Client) distinction in both OVPAA-F-INS-032 and ADM.
Lesson: In Capstone 2, the Action Done Matrix must never be locked; it serves as the live working record during oral hearings and the basis for post-defense manuscript revisions.
